record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For any irreducible generic representation Π of the finite symplectic group Sp_{2n}(F_{q^2}), determine the branching multiplicity dim Hom_{Sp_{2n}(F_q)}(Π, ω) for the Weil representation ω.

evidence.quote: Over finite fields, we can also consider this restriction problem for symplectic groups. For any irreducible generic representation Π of Sp2n(Fq2), one would thus like to determine dim HomSp2n(Fq)(Π, ω).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q$ be a prime power and let $\mathbb{F}_q\subset \mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ be the corresponding quadratic extension of finite fields. Let $(V,\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle)$ be a non-degenerate symplectic space of dimension $2n$ over $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$, and let $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2})$ denote its isometry group. Viewing $V$ as a $4n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_q$, the trace form $\mathrm{tr}_{\mathbb{F}_{q^2}/\mathbb{F}_q}\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ endows it with the structure of a $4n$-dimensional symplectic space over $\mathbb{F}_q$, and there is a natural embedding $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2}) \hookrightarrow \mathrm{Sp}_{4n}(\mathbb{F}_q)$. Inside $\mathrm{Sp}_{4n}(\mathbb{F}_q)$ sits the subgroup $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)\times\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)$ (acting on a fixed orthogonal decomposition $V=V_+\oplus V_-$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ obtained from a trace-zero element of $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$), and via the diagonal we obtain an embedding $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)\hookrightarrow \mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2})$.

Fix a non-trivial additive character $\psi:\mathbb{F}_q\to\mathbb{C}^\times$ and let $\omega=\omega_\psi$ be the associated Weil representation of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)$ (of dimension $q^n$). Recall that an irreducible representation $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2})$ is called generic if it admits a non-zero Whittaker functional with respect to a generic character of a maximal unipotent subgroup.

Problem: For every irreducible generic representation $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2})$, determine the branching multiplicity
$$\dim \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)}\bigl(\Pi,\ \omega\bigr).$$
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published determination of $\dim\mathrm{Hom}_{\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_q)}(\Pi,\omega)$ for all irreducible generic $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(\mathbb{F}_{q^2})$. Related work on Weil representations over finite fields and on branching for symplectic groups exists, but no source explicitly resolves this twisted GGP-type multiplicity in full generality. The status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Weil's representations of the symplectic groups over finite fields
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Weil representations of Sp(2n,K) over a finite field K, but does not address the twisted symplectic branching multiplicity at hand.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational reference on the Weil representation over finite fields; does not resolve the stated branching problem.

status_evidence.title: An analysis of the multiplicity spaces in branching of symplectic groups
status_evidence.snippet: Branching of symplectic groups is not multiplicity free; multiplicity spaces have an SL(2)^n structure.
status_evidence.claim: Discusses symplectic branching in a different (complex/algebraic) setting, not the finite-field twisted symplectic restriction in question.
